panels.description: Status over time per script, classified consistently with Status distribution over time. Use Category, Region, and Tag to filter scripts; Region and Tag support comma-separated multi-value metadata. Older agents without detail metrics fall back to Restricted or Other failure.

targets.expr:
(
  (miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 1)
  or
  ((miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 0.5)
    unless on(job, instance, id)
      miaoprobe_probe_warning_info{instance=~"$instance", class="access"})
  or
  (((miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 0.5)
    and on(job, instance, id)
      miaoprobe_probe_warning_info{instance=~"$instance", class="access"}) * 0.5)
  or
  ((miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 0)
    and on(job, instance, id)
      miaoprobe_probe_failure_info{instance=~"$instance", class="availability"})
  or
  (((miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 0)
    and on(job, instance, id)
      miaoprobe_probe_failure_info{instance=~"$instance", class="network"}) - 0.25)
  or
  (((miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == 0)
    unless on(job, instance, id)
      miaoprobe_probe_failure_info{instance=~"$instance", class=~"availability|network"}) - 0.5)
  or
  (miaoprobe_unlock_status{instance=~"$instance"} == -1)
)
* on(job, instance, id) group_left(name, category, region, tags)
  miaoprobe_script_info{
    instance=~"$instance",
    category=~"${category:regex}",
    region=~"(^|.*,)${region:regex}(,.*|$)",
    tags=~"(^|.*,)${tag:regex}(,.*|$)"
  }

panels.description: Time since each script last produced a usable status. A sawtooth that resets every polling interval is healthy; a line that climbs without resetting means that script's status is frozen and stale.

panels.description: Wall time of a full polling cycle across all scripts. If this approaches the configured --probe.interval, ticks get dropped and the effective polling rate silently degrades: raise --probe.concurrency or --probe.interval. Set the dashed threshold to your --probe.interval.

targets.expr: miaoprobe_poll_duration_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}
